subject.title: feat(ui): camera-off glyph and remembered camera state for talk calls

question: Should the remembered camera preference be permitted to request camera access before a Talk call has successfully reached `listening`, or must it remain deferred until the call is active?
rationale: This feature changes when a browser may request camera access across future calls; the safest technical path is clear, but the final user-consent behavior belongs to the feature owner.

options.title: Defer until listening
options.body: Trigger remembered camera enable only after the current session reports `listening`, avoiding camera prompts for calls that never become active.

options.title: Allow pre-listening prompts
options.body: Keep capability-time auto-enable and explicitly accept that failed microphone or transport startup may still request camera access.

recommendation.title: Defer until listening
recommendation.body: Trigger remembered camera enable only after the current session reports `listening`, avoiding camera prompts for calls that never become active.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the merged Talk-camera behavior and authored the follow-up preference design.
